g.text: The challenge is a server event.
The first client frame is connect.
Device identity and pairing support broad Gateway access.
The v1 AsyncAPI documents a token query parameter.
The baseline route shown here extracts only conversation_id.
There is no connect protocol negotiation.
CampusAgent v2 target: HTTP opening handshake
preserve full path, principal, and Upgrade
No business query parameter and no URL token.
Browsers cannot call this endpoint directly.
The wss URI requests establishment; it is not an open WebSocket.
The HTTPS form is a handshake target, not a REST API.
HTTP 101 creates transport; connect binds the session.
The connection cannot switch agent or session.
URL v1 and Frame protocol 2 are independent versions.
Inbound JWT is never forwarded to a Manager.
Unknown capabilities are ignored and not echoed.
Typed structured delta is not a capability.
Effective features do not replace request authorization.
